item.title: Gruesome scene as four decapitated bodies left in abandoned car near government building
item.description: WARNING: DISTRESSING CONTENT: The four decapitated bodies were found inside an abandoned car near the state congress building in the Mexican state of Guerrero
item.author: Maria Ortega,Robin Cottle

media:content.media:description: The vehicle where the remains of the mayor of Chilpancingo, Alejandro Arcos of the Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) were found is transported on a flatbed truck in Chilpancingo, Guerrero state, on October 6, 2024. The mayor of the southern Mexican city of Chilpancingo has been killed, authorities said Sunday, the latest in a series of killings against politicians in the violence-ravaged Latin American country. (Photo by Jesus GUERRERO / AFP) (Photo by JESUS GUERRERO/AFP via Getty Images)
